# Lore
[italic]"Building Better Worlds."[/italic]
Each round, your [bold]lore primer[/bold] in the character menu gives the exact date, information about the faction(s) present, information about possible threat(s) and information about the place you find yourself.
## The State of the World Humanity has spread far beyond Earth, but the stars have done little to make civilization safer, fairer, or more united. The great powers compete across an increasingly fractured frontier, while megacorporations such as Weyland-Yutani wield influence comparable to governments themselves. Colonial worlds range from prosperous industrial centers to isolated settlements barely connected to the wider human sphere, protected by overstretched military forces, local garrisons, and whatever security their owners can afford. Communication is slow, travel is dangerous, and entire colonies can disappear before anyone realizes something is wrong. The frontier is expanding, tensions between the great powers are rising, and everywhere humanity is moving toward conflicts it may not be prepared to survive.
